name: MANNAT
message:
Happy Birthday, my love! ❤️🎂

Today is all about celebrating the beautiful person you are. I feel incredibly lucky to have you in my life, and I hope you always know how special you are to me.

You bring so much happiness, warmth, and love into my world. Every moment with you becomes a memory I want to keep forever. 🥹❤️

On your birthday, I wish you endless happiness, success, peace, and everything your heart desires. I promise to keep making you smile, keep annoying you a little 😜, and keep loving you more with every passing day.

Happy Birthday to my beautiful girl. 🎀❤️
You deserve the whole world, and I hope I can always be a part of making your world a little more beautiful.

I love you. ❤️🎂✨**
